rule: This checkpoint does not derive Newton's constant; it fixes how local residuals are normalized against the observed/calibrated Newtonian channel for R10.
Once an object is stored as alpha_i(lambda), K_NH/K_edge/K_tr/Pi_R10 cannot be tuned separately.
Raw parent-action residuals must pass through the projection functional before using the unit-normalized finite gate.
R10 finite scoring uses the sum of absolute projected components unless exact same-branch zeros are signed.
